W42

Question bank

/teach/courses/:courseId/question-bank
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: follow-on

Reuse staff-only question versions while preventing bank edits from changing published or attempted quizzes.

W41 add from bankW35 assessment tools

Question detailPrompt, response schema, correct key and rationale

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Retire question
  • Future selection disabled; usage references retained
  • Pinned quizzes and attempt snapshots unchanged
Return without applying changesRetire from future selection
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Question option order supports labelled Move up/down buttons; key selection works by keyboard.
  • Rich prompts require text equivalents for diagrams/equations and descriptive errors; status never relies on colour.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Saving bank v2 leaves a quiz using v1 unchanged.
  • Learner search and page source expose no bank keys or rationale.
  • Invalid imported questions remain excluded with row-level errors and no partial silent insertion.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
  • TA authoring is disabled in initial HTML; listed authoring actions require a separately approved future grant.
